summary: Iteration 35 — frontend bulk flow + rebrand (TREDI → TradaBooks). Mobile 390x844, logged in as owner@tredi.app. BULK FLOW (PASS): /stock/bulk renders bulk-items-screen with empty-state card 'No items yet'. 'Add item' (bulk-add-item) opens /stock/new?collect=1 titled 'Add to list'; filled item-name 'ZZ Bulk Item A' → item-next → item-cost 100 / item-sell 150 / item-opening 5 → final button reads exactly 'Add item to list' (item-save) → router.back lands on /stock/bulk with bulk-row-0 showing '5 Piece × ₦100 · sells ₦150' and ₦500 line total. Added a 2nd item (B, 3×200/300) → bulk-row-1 appears, bulk-total = ₦1,100. Tapped bulk-row-0 and the New-item form reopened with name prefilled 'ZZ Bulk Item A', AppBar title 'Edit list item', item-save label 'Update item on list'. Removed bulk-row-1 (now gone), re-added a 3rd item (C, 2×50/80); bulk-save label became exactly 'Save 2 items'. Clicking bulk-save POSTed /api/items/bulk → 201. API verification: GET /api/items shows both ZZ Bulk Item A (qty 5, cost 100, sell 150) and ZZ Bulk Item C (qty 2, cost 50, sell 80); GET /api/purchases shows exactly ONE new PO with supplier_name='Opening stock', method='opening', total=600, paid=600, due=0, 2 lines (A, C) — meets spec. REGRESSION (PASS): plain /stock/new (no collect) → item-save label 'Save item', saved ZZ Regress Single and navigated to /stock/<id>. /purchases/new renders new-purchase-screen with purchase-pick-supplier / purchase-add-item / purchase-method-credit/cash/transfer / purchase-paid / purchase-date / purchase-save all present. REBRAND (MIXED): PASS on sign-in, onboarding, setup-business copy, home dashboard, legal/terms (TradaBooks everywhere), More tab footer 'TradaBooks · rev 05 · Made with TradaBooks', app.json name='TradaBooks', splash asset is tradabooks-logo-green.png (testID splash-logo in app/index.tsx:45 — the splash flashes under 1s before auto-routing so it was not caught in a screenshot but code is correct). FAIL: visible 'tredi/TREDI' brand text remains on /admin/login ('tredi' word-mark + 'ADMIN.TREDI.APP/LOGIN' subtitle + prefilled email 'superadmin@tredi.app'), on the admin side-rail (src/admin/ui.tsx:383 'tredi · Super Admin' shown on every admin page), on every admin page subtitle 'admin.tredi.app/<path>', on /settings/invoice ('tredi mark on invoices' heading), on /admin/configuration ('tredi mark in footer'), and in the generated business-card PDF ('made with tredi' in app/tools/business-card.tsx:69). Seeded demo data still named 'Tredi Ventures' with placeholder 'Tredi Ventures' in /setup-business:58 — this is user/content data, not strictly branding, but it is still visible to the owner on first run. No pageerror / no React red-screen. No deprecated expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch found in the touched files.

Side-rail brand text still renders 'tredi · Super Admin' on every admin page (line 383). Rebrand must replace with 'TradaBooks · Super Admin' and refresh the circular 't' badge.

integration_issues.issue: Works end-to-end. The only cosmetic hiccup is a dev-only 'The action GO_BACK was not handled' toast after bulk-save because /stock/bulk was opened by a deep link — same as iter34, not a user-facing bug on real devices.

action_items: Rebrand the Super Admin surface: replace the lower-case 'tredi' word-mark in src/admin/ui.tsx (left rail) and app/admin/login.tsx (big splash + ADMIN.TREDI.APP/LOGIN subtitle) with the TradaBooks mark. The 'tredi' string appears in roughly 15 admin files via the sub='admin.tredi.app/<path>' prop — a single find-and-replace across app/admin/**/*.tsx is enough.

Replace user-visible copy: app/settings/invoice.tsx:112 'tredi mark on invoices' → 'TradaBooks mark on invoices'; app/admin/configuration.tsx:87 'tredi mark in footer' → 'TradaBooks mark in footer'; app/tools/business-card.tsx:69 'made with tredi' → 'made with TradaBooks'.

Update seeded demo content so the first-run owner sees TradaBooks: rename the demo business ('Tredi Ventures' → something branded), update placeholder in app/setup-business.tsx:58, and consider adding a TradaBooks test account in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

The testID 'pdf-tredi-mark' on the invoice watermark is kept per request — fine, but the comment/variable names (src/invoice-templates.ts:51 'The tredi mark', src/components/invoice-paper.tsx MARK const) can be renamed for maintainability.

Cropper-after-photo-pick on /stock/new was not re-driven from the web preview this iteration (expo-image-picker can't be driven headlessly) — iter34 already covered the wiring. Recommend one manual mobile smoke to confirm.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/stock/bulk.tsx:38-50 — save mutation sends supplier=first-row-supplier (or '') and invalidates ['items','items-stats','low-stock','dashboard','purchases','suppliers','lookup']; good: Purchases list refreshes without a manual pull.

frontend/app/stock/bulk.tsx:36 — on unmount the module-level draft is cleared. Correct for the 'leave the screen = drop the list' intent, but note that if a user accidentally hits the system back during the two-screen flow (bulk → new?collect=1 → save), going back to a prior tab wipes the list. The in-flow back from /stock/new?collect=1 to /stock/bulk is OK because /stock/bulk is still mounted (ScrollView stays alive).

frontend/app/stock/new.tsx:125-129 — addToList() uses params.row key for edit; bulkDraft.put correctly merges by key. The toast says 'added to the list' vs 'updated' depending on params.row — nice detail.

frontend/app/stock/new.tsx:159-167 — AppBar title string is correct across the four states (New item / Edit item / Add to list / Edit list item). The right-side '+ Several' pill only renders when !editId && !collect && step===0 — matches spec.

frontend/src/bulk-draft.ts — module-level mutable state + useSyncExternalStore. Fine for a single-user single-flow screen, but note it is global: if the user opens two different browser tabs or re-enters by a wild deep link they would share the same list. Low risk.

Rebrand code review: 'tredi' is still hard-coded in 20+ files under app/admin/, src/admin/ui.tsx, app/settings/invoice.tsx, app/admin/configuration.tsx, app/tools/business-card.tsx, src/pdf.ts (default filename 'tredi-print.pdf'), src/invoice-templates.ts comments, and the exportCsv filenames 'tredi-businesses', 'tredi-audit-log', 'tredi-users', 'tredi-analytics-*' in admin/*.tsx. These should be renamed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (iter34 regression — not re-run; 1 live spot-check via GET /api/items + /api/purchases passed)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% — bulk flow + regressions PASS; rebrand FAIL on admin + 3 user-facing strings

seed_data_creation: Created via UI: ZZ Bulk Item A (qty 5), ZZ Bulk Item C (qty 2) and one 'Opening stock' PO; via regression: ZZ Regress Single. All removed afterwards (API delete + motor sweep: items=3 deleted, purchases=1 deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The bulk flow uses router.back() after bulk-save; when /stock/bulk was reached by a direct URL (goto) the navigator stack is empty and dev-mode shows 'GO_BACK was not handled' toast. Prefer entering via Stock tab layers icon (testID stock-bulk-add) or via the '+ Several' pill (testID item-add-several) on /stock/new, both of which push onto a real stack. For the opening-stock PO backend check, GET /api/purchases returns a top-level array (not {purchases:[...]}) — same for GET /api/items; the test helper should isinstance-guard both shapes. Admin pages are desktop-first — use 1280x800 viewport. The invoice PDF watermark testID is still 'pdf-tredi-mark' by design (requested) even after rebrand; the underlying asset filename is tradabooks-wordmark.png.
rca_of_issue: Rebrand FAIL — root cause: the TREDI→TradaBooks pass covered app shell (app.json, splash asset, sign-in / onboarding / setup copy, legal docs, dashboard header fallback, invoice watermark asset) but missed the Super Admin surface and a few scattered user-visible labels. Repro: open https://ui-flow-accurate.preview.emergentagent.com/admin/login — the hero word-mark says 'tredi' and the subtitle says ADMIN.TREDI.APP/LOGIN. Also open /settings/invoice — the 'tredi mark on invoices' section remains. Mitigation: global find-and-replace in app/admin/**/*.tsx, src/admin/ui.tsx, app/settings/invoice.tsx, app/admin/configuration.tsx, app/tools/business-card.tsx. Keep testIDs (pdf-tredi-mark, settings-tredi-mark) stable to avoid breaking existing E2E suites, or coordinate renaming them with the test suite.
